findings.title: Preview posts can arrive after final result
findings.message: After a nativeBusy/panel-in-flight guard, the Preview callback posts to the window and the final Publish check only tests the epoch. If the picker change fires while busy it is disabled, but fontPreview is overwritten on every change; more importantly, the preview callback checks nativeBusy but a completed/cancelled session with a stale preview can still land after Publish, leaving fontPreview different from accepted on failure paths is reset, but on success it's fine. Minor race ordering between PostWindow and Publish may apply stale preview after final value.
findings.suggestion: Ensure preview posts are ordered before the Publish or guard with an epoch-done flag set in the Publish closure (nativeBusy is already false then, so verify ordering).

findings.title: Font panel accessory built with color-specific cast and 'Use Color' label
findings.message: The font panel's accessory view is set via a cast to NSColorPanel, and the buttons are titled 'Use Color'. NSFontPanel is not an NSColorPanel and may not respond to setAccessoryView: (NSFontPanel has setAccessoryView:, but the cast is unsafe). The docs and the Use Font button promise 'Use Font', yet the title remains 'Use Color'. Cleanup also calls the same cast on the font panel.
findings.suggestion: Cast to NSFontPanel for font mode, and parameterize the apply button title ('Use Font' vs 'Use Color').
